**Cocycle Actions on Hidden Quantum Markov Models:**

*Symmetry Protection and Topological Order*

17 pp, 4 sections.

**Abstract.** We develop a symmetry action framework for hidden quantum Markov models (HQMMs) tailored to one-dimensional quantum spin systems and symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases. In our setting, a symmetry groupGacts projectively on the hidden (virtual) degrees of freedom and linearly on the physical observation space, yielding a global HQMM state that is invariant under the combined action ofGfor both conventional and causal (input– output) structures. We show that such symmetry actions are naturally classified by a group- cohomology 2-cocycle [ω]∈H 2(G,U(1)), in direct analogy with the standard cohomological classification of one-dimensional bosonic SPT phases via projective edge representations. As an explicit example, we apply this construction to the Affleck–Kennedy–Lieb–Tasaki (AKLT) chain, where the hidden layer carries a nontrivial class [ω]∈H 2(SO(3),U(1)) encoding its SPT order.

**Outline.** Introduction; Cocycle Actions and Symmetry Protection in HQM; Discussion and Outlook; Appedix: Hidden Quantum Markov Models
